verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no bulk operation that acts on many flags, experiments, or metrics at once. The closest items are adjacent rather than direct. The toggle endpoint switches a single flag across one or more environments, a draft publishes many changes to one feature at once, and the general REST API is only a building block a user could script loops against.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
